        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        # Histories are LEFT padded; count-1 indexes padding on short histories.
        positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=seq.device).expand_as(seq)
        last = positions.masked_fill(seq == 0, -1).max(dim=1).values.clamp(min=0)
        return out[torch.arange(seq.size(0), device=seq.device), last]

    def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        pos_scores = (out * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_scores = (out * self.item_emb(neg)).sum(dim=-1)
        return pos_scores, neg_scores

def _interest_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=seq.device)
        distances = positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
        weights = torch.exp2(-distances.clamp(min=0).to(out.dtype) / 4.0)
        weights = weights.masked_fill(distances < 0, 0.0)
        real = seq.ne(0).to(out.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
        numerator = torch.matmul(weights, out * real)
        denominator = torch.matmul(real.squeeze(-1), weights.transpose(0, 1)).unsqueeze(-1)
        mean = numerator / denominator.clamp(min=torch.finfo(out.dtype).tiny)
        return (0.8 * out + 0.2 * mean) * real
